reason: A Tavily integration for DeepSeek Harness that provides configurable web search, full Tavily search controls, credential-backed API access, and guarded compatibility patches for supported Harness versions.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 Tavily 的可配置网页搜索、完整搜索参数控制和凭据管理集成。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with configurable Tavily-backed web search, full search parameter controls, and credential management.

capabilities: Provides Tavily-backed web search through standalone and official search tools
Sends search queries and enabled search controls to the Tavily API
Stores and manages a Tavily API key through the host credentials interface
Applies guarded compatibility patches to installed DeepSeek Harness modules
Exposes plugin configuration and value-free status through the host interface
